question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO: Both YES prongs permanently foreclosed since July 17 mandatory dissolution. Coalition confirmed at ≥61 seats (62-0 vote, coalition-only) at dissolution — first full-term completion since 1988. No parliamentary body exists in which a coalition majority can be formally counted or lost before Oct 27. No mechanism exists to accelerate the legally fixed Oct 27 election date.
resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO.
resolution_note: Knesset dissolved July 17, 2026, via 62-0 vote backed exclusively by coalition members, confirming ≥61 seats at dissolution — first full-term completion since 1988 (Times of Israel, PBS). Both YES prongs permanently foreclosed: prong (a) requires a roll-call Knesset confidence vote, impossible with dissolved Knesset; prong (b) requires election moved earlier than Oct 27, Israeli electoral law contains no such mechanism. Coalition survived to mandatory dissolution with majority intact.

question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO: Horizon passed. No qualifying unconditional commitment issued within window.
resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, SNSC, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States.
resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
resolution_note: From EOD Sep 3 through EOD Sep 6, no named Iranian official issued a public statement committing to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations. Pezeshkian's Sep 1 conditional statement predated the window and is caught by the ambiguity rule. FM Araghchi explicitly rejected temporary ceasefire during the window. Trump rejected any deal Sep 2. Resolution criteria unmet.

question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO: Horizon passed. No qualifying formal session occurred; Islamabad Talks (April 11-12) remained last session.
resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.
resolution_note: No formally convened indirect negotiating session with named mediator occurred before EOD Sep 17. Islamabad Talks (April 11–12) remained the last qualifying session. Trump's Sep 16–17 'direct contact' claim not confirmed by any named Iranian official. Message relay via Oman and Qatar continued but did not constitute a formally convened session with a named mediator present.
